dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! The much-awaited Great Magician's Night of Fantasy will soon be held at the Opera Epiclese!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The Great Magician Lyney himself will take the stage and bring forth miracles on the border of truth and trickery once more!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Lady Furina, Monsieur Neuvillette, and many other notables shall grace this most grand occasion with their presence!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep-boop! Would you like to know more? Subscribe to The Steambird today!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! The legendary bandit, the Phantom Weasel, has reemerged after over a decade of silence! A letter has been sent, a challenge delivered at the Opera Epiclese — one has to ask, who sent it?

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Watch your treasures, O ye wealthy. Guard your children, honest citizens! The Weasel has returned!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep-boop! Would you like to know more about the Weasel's curious case? Follow The Steambird's exclusive interview!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! Monteverdi's famous opera, "Tancrede et Chariclea," will be showing at the Opera Epiclese once more!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The renowned actor team-up of Frederick the Quicksilver and Monserrat Cavalle will be returning!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! The philanthropist Gardon sues children under 12 in his care for "taking up dangerous work without authorization." He demands compensation for all illegal wages and economic losses!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: This case may come down to a duel between duelists!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! Another 20 redundant departments formerly belonging to the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering have been abolished! Experts claim that this will speed the rebuilding process up by 30 years!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: A grave tragedy! A legendary Champion Duelist's 30-year undefeated streak has been shattered!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Guillaume Marais, the renowned Champion Duelist, suffered fatal cardiac arrest at home from a wheel lock pistol misfire while explaining the duel that made him famous to a guest!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! The construction of the Lumidouce Harbor Line will start soon! Estimates say that the line will be available within a decade!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! All citizens, please beware of the baseless rumors that "the construction of the Lumidouce Harbor Line will start soon"!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Want to learn the secret behind Fontaine's Fish and Chips and its delicious flavor? Visit Haines Food Factory on Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday to explore the long history of our local felicitous flavors!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Recently, Francis the Blue Moon has once more denied any accusations of nepotistic relations with the Borja Family—

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "Um, I don't know what you're... uh, asking about. There's no such thing as a mafia in Fontaine."

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Murder! Murder most foul! Three bodies have been discovered on the west side of the former Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The victims cannot be identified, but the fishtail-and-red-bull insignia of the Borja Family was left on the scene. This might have been a purging operation by the Borjas.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Today's interview at The Steambird! Famed Epiclese director, Coppola Prizzi, personally explains the masterpiece "Apocalypse When?" Lovely posters come with this edition!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! Ms. Mequignon, the great master, will be holding a fashion exhibition at Bertin's House of Curiosities. "Ancient Mysteries" shall welcome you, all ye fashionistas of exquisite taste!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! "Big Fish" Alejandro of the Borja Family passed on recently. His illegitimate son, "Priest" Cesare has temporarily taken charge as clan patriarch.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Experts say that this will inevitably plunge the Family into chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! Zaha Hadi, the renowned architect from Sumeru, will soon conduct a new concept construction exhibition.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Disaster! Disaster! At a recent public exhibition, the Babich Automated Analysis Engine suddenly exploded in a shower of gears, causing great injury and death to onlookers!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Mr. Babich himself was severely injured and remains unconscious!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Analysts' Guild President Marco Borja has opined that this tragedy was nonetheless an inevitable step on the path to progress, and that the Guild expresses its deep sympathies and condolences.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! Lady Furina will personally attend a clock exhibition and admire both the latest and greatest machines as well as ancient clockwork relics alongside artisan machine hobbyists!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep-boop — Considering the somewhat whimsical arrangement, Lady Furina may not arrive on time. Event-goers are advised to make the appropriate arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering makes a statement about the explosion the day before yesterday!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The accident was caused by improper operations in violation of regulations! The Institute has launched an emergency investigation! Those responsible will face the consequences!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: #Extra! Extra! Incident at the Palais Mermonia! Is the {M#Blond}{F#Blonde} Traveler involved?

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: #According to our sources, the {M#Blond}{F#Blonde} Traveler and their companion, who assisted in investigating the serial disappearances of young women case, have been arrested by the Maison Gardiennage and sent to the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The Maison Ordalie has charged them with crimes comparable to an attempted assassination on Lady Furina, leading to all sorts of speculation about the truth!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: How will this sudden turn of events affect Fontaine? Get this special issue for the latest information on this brewing storm!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! Sir Arthur's regular maintenance has been completed successfully to continue providing high-quality news and information to everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Please do not believe any rumors about his so-called theft.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Fontaine is a place of law and order, certainly no place for Sir Arthur to be "publicly stolen and split into three!"

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! The floods caused by the huge, unknown creature have finally subsided, thanks to everyone's united efforts! The disaster has been minimized, and the situation is under control!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep-boop! What was the cause of the floods? And how will the reconstruction be carried out?

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Get this free special issue to bring you that first ray of sunshine after the rain!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Today's exclusive interview in the Steambird! President Navia Caspar of Spina di Rosula passionately shares the details of the Poisson reconstruction plan with us!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "While hope remains, old soil can still give birth to new bloom."

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: A miracle of modern clockwork engineering science and the ark that saved the world — the Wingalet! How did this mysterious airship come to be?

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Keep your eyes peeled for this special interview that will bring you a real first-hand report from beneath the depths!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Mr. Jurieu, the lead engineer behind the Wingalet and a former researcher, recently declined an invitation from Fontaine Research Institute!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "I must stay for the time being due to personal reasons and cannot return to the surface on my own."

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Recently, a rumor has been silently creeping through the Court of Fontaine — "The prophecy was true! Lady Furina saved us all! Everything went according to her plan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep boop! I'm certain you've all caught wind of it! What is the truth behind it all? We'll persist with our in-depth investigations and reports!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Recently, a rumor has been silently creeping through the Court of Fontaine — "The prophecy was true! Lady Furina saved us all! Everything went according to her plan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep boop! I'm certain you've all caught wind of it! Though Lady Furina has declined a special interview with us, we'll persist with our in-depth investigations and reports!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! The Fontaine Film Association is hosting the Fontinalia Film Festival! Famous directors will be meeting at the Court of Fontaine to compete for the Furina Award!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! The Special Security and Surveillance Patrol will be setting up a booth during the Fontinalia Film Festival so that you, too, can enjoy the thrill of firing a musket!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "Anyone can be a 'Musketeer' here! However, bringing your own weapon is strictly prohibited! Violators will be arrested by the Gardes!"

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Fontaine's new director of "Experimental Cinema," Melies, vows to win the Furina Award, and is recruiting stunt doubles! Pay is negotiable!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra! Extra! The group of criminals that recently attempted an attack on the Clementine Line have been arrested by the Maison Gardiennage and Spina di Rosula!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Navia Caspar, the president of the Spina, stated in an interview that the incident has been completely resolved —your safety on the aquabus remains guaranteed.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: She also mentioned that the Spina is planning to reconstruct the Callas Line and add more stops for the existing aquabus lines.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Don't miss our must-read special issue if you want to know more!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: The renowned fashion brand "Chioriya" has launched a slew of new products, attracting swathes of customers from across the world!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: This owes much to her outstanding performance at Fontaine Fashion Week.

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: According to a certain critic, "This might be a turning point for Chioriya Boutique... Nay, for the entire field of Fontainian fashion!"
